title: Тон и уместность речи
description: Выбираем естественные сочетания и меняем тон просьбы в зависимости от ситуации.
objectives: Использовать устойчивые сочетания без буквального перевода
notes: Raise a concern — выразить опасение; make a decision — принять решение.
Неформальное get back to you можно заменить более формальным respond to you, сохранив смысл.

public_payload.sentence: I would like to ___ a concern about the schedule.

exercises.prompt: Выбери близкое по смыслу выражение в рабочей переписке.
exercises.explanation: Get back to someone в этом контексте означает ответить или связаться позже.

exercises.prompt: Выбери уместную просьбу руководителю о переносе срока.

options.label: I have never had any deadlines anywhere.
Would it be possible to extend the deadline until Monday?
Give me more time, or else.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: Is everything on track for Friday?

lines.speaker: Analyst
lines.text: I need more time to check the figures.

exercises.editorial_answer: Would it be possible to extend the deadline until Monday?
exercises.explanation: Would it be possible …? — вежливая конкретная просьба; угроза неуместна.

exercises.prompt: Какую разницу в тоне объясняет текст?

options.label: Longer messages are automatically more accurate.
The same deadline can be expressed with different degrees of politeness.
A professional message must always avoid stating a deadline.

public_payload.passage: Two colleagues need the same information from a supplier. One writes, “Send the figures today.” The other writes, “Could you please send the figures by the end of today?” Both messages state a deadline, but the second frames the request more politely. This does not mean that every business message should be long or indirect. A short message can still be professional if it gives the necessary context and shows reasonable consideration for the reader.

exercises.editorial_answer: The same deadline can be expressed with different degrees of politeness.
exercises.explanation: Обе просьбы задают срок, но вторая вежливее. Автор не утверждает, что длина гарантирует качество.

accepted: Please take the additional costs into account.
Please take into account the additional costs.

exercises.reference_answer: Please take the additional costs into account.
exercises.editorial_answer: Please take the additional costs into account.
exercises.explanation: Take into account / consider означает учитывать; ignore — противоположное действие.

public_payload.sentence: We need to do a decision before Friday.

accepted: We need to make a decision before Friday.

exercises.reference_answer: We need to make a decision before Friday.
exercises.incorrect_answer: We need to avoid a decision before Friday.
exercises.editorial_answer: We need to make a decision before Friday.
exercises.explanation: Говорят make a decision, а не do a decision. Смысл необходимости решения сохраняется.

exercises.editorial_answer: Could you let me know when I can expect a response?
exercises.explanation: Could you let me know …? — вежливый запрос; внутри косвенного вопроса порядок I can expect.

exercises.prompt: Проверь гипотезы, осторожность и связность B2.

options.label: If I would have checked, I had noticed.
If I had checked, I would have noticed.
Despite we were late, we finished.

explanations.q1: If + Past Perfect сочетается с would have + причастие.
explanations.q2: Might have left допускает событие, но не подтверждает его.
explanations.q3: После despite подходит существительное; для придаточного нужен although.

exercises.editorial_answer: If I had checked, I would have noticed.; They might have left early.; Despite the delay, we finished.
exercises.explanation: Контрольный блок засчитывается при всех верных ответах. Разбор каждого вопроса показан отдельно.
